record.paper_title: Open Problems in Global Analysis. Structured Foliations and the Information Geometry
record.original_question: Given a differentiable manifold M, determine whether M admits a locally flat geometric structure.

evidence.quote: Locally ﬂat structure in a manifold M

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth (differentiable) manifold of dimension $n$. A locally flat (affine) structure on $M$ is a maximal atlas of coordinate charts $\{(U_\alpha, \varphi_\alpha)\}$ with $\varphi_\alpha : U_\alpha \to \mathbb{R}^n$ such that every transition map $\varphi_\beta \circ \varphi_\alpha^{-1}$, defined on $\varphi_\alpha(U_\alpha \cap U_\beta)$, is the restriction of an affine transformation of $\mathbb{R}^n$ (equivalently, a torsion-free flat affine connection on $TM$).

Problem: Give necessary and sufficient conditions on $M$ for the existence of a locally flat structure. In particular, characterize, in terms of the topology and smooth structure of $M$, exactly which differentiable manifolds admit such a structure.
artifact.status_search_result: The general problem of characterizing which manifolds admit a locally flat (affine) structure is a long-standing open problem in affine differential geometry. Related conjectures such as Chern's conjecture (vanishing of the Euler characteristic of a compact affine manifold) remain open in full generality, although special cases (dimension 2, complete affine manifolds, the special/parallel-volume case by Klingler) have been resolved. No general necessary and sufficient topological criterion is known.

status_evidence.title: Chern's conjecture (affine geometry) - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Chern's conjecture states that the Euler characteristic of a compact affine manifold vanishes. As of 2025, it remains an unsolved mathematical problem.
status_evidence.claim: Existence/obstruction theory for affine (locally flat) structures on manifolds remains open in general; related Chern conjecture is still unsolved.

status_evidence.title: Chern's conjecture for special affine manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Klingler proved Chern's conjecture for affine manifolds admitting a parallel volume form.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results are known; the general existence problem for locally flat structures is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Affine manifold - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Determining which manifolds admit affine structures is a difficult open question.
status_evidence.claim: The classification problem for manifolds admitting a locally flat structure is open.
